procedure_summary: The methyl ester of the chloro bromomethyl methanesulfonyl benzoic acid is cleaved by the procedure of the earlier worked example to give the sodium benzoate salt, the benzylic bromide being left intact. No procedure, reagent or charge is printed here; only the product and its stated content are given.
notes: Cross-reference only. This paragraph prints no procedure for step (1): it says the procedure is the same as the one described in Example 1 and states the product content as 98.2 percent. The product is nonetheless a salt. Confidence is medium because the classification rests on the referenced procedure rather than on anything written here. seal the solid and set it aside for use

procedure_text: 向反应釜中加入50mL  2-四氢呋喃甲醇，开动搅拌，室温下投入2.8g金属钠(99％，0.12mol)，搅拌至溶解完全，经高真空油泵负压脱溶后得到2-四氢呋喃甲醇醇钠固体，密封备用。
procedure_summary: Sodium metal is added to tetrahydrofurfuryl alcohol in a stirred reaction kettle at room temperature and stirred until it has dissolved completely, converting the alcohol into its sodium alkoxide. The excess alcohol is stripped off under reduced pressure with a high vacuum oil pump and the solid alkoxide is sealed and set aside for use.
notes: The patent prints this preparation inside its step (2), but it is a transformation in its own right, with its own charge and its own isolated product, so it gets its own record. The step label Step 2a says where the document puts it while leaving the document's own marker for the etherification record that follows. A0 estimated three steps for this section and this annotation emits three, so the counts agree: the cross-referenced step (1), this alkoxide preparation, and the etherification. Tetrahydrofurfuryl alcohol is both the medium and the reagent consumed, since the sodium dissolves in it and the excess is then stripped off, so it is carried as a reactant in agreement with A1, and solvent_class carries both neat, no separate solvent being added, and protic, the medium being an alcohol. reaction_class salt_formation is the closest of the permitted values: the alcohol is deprotonated and what is isolated is its sodium salt. Confidence is medium because the process is formally a dissolving metal reaction, so electron transfer and hydrogen evolution are implied, and no permitted class names alkoxide formation directly; other was the alternative. mechanism_type ionic records the net transfer of the hydroxyl proton to the metal, and the text states no mechanism. No inert atmosphere, no reaction time and no stirrer type are given, so those fields stay null even though sodium metal is normally handled under inert gas; nothing is inferred here, and the sealing of the solid is recorded as a workup step rather than read as an atmosphere. safety_notes is empty because the text makes no safety statement, and no hazard of ours is added. The vacuum stripping is recorded as the workup concentration method and not as a reaction pressure, since removal of solvent under reduced pressure is a workup operation. The Chinese name the patent prints for the alcohol is not a well formed name, as A1 records; it is kept as printed and not corrected. No arrow is drawn for this preparation: the section's only scheme lists the sodium alkoxide as a condition of the etherification arrow, and its counter ion agrees with the prose. The mass, strength and mole figures printed for the sodium charge close, so no arithmetic flag is raised; the working is in the provenance sidecar.

conditions.ph_target_stage: workup acidification of the aqueous kettle residue with concentrated hydrochloric acid to pH 3

steps: strip off the solvent under reduced pressure
add water to the kettle residue and stir to dissolve
add concentrated hydrochloric acid dropwise to acidify the system to pH 3

compounds.addition_profile: the DMSO is added to the solid alkoxide and stirred to dissolve it
added to the solid alkoxide and stirred to dissolve before the kettle was cooled and the benzoate salt was charged
added in eight portions with a total addition time of 2 h, at a controlled kettle temperature of -5 C
added to the kettle residue after the solvent was stripped, and stirred to dissolve it; also used to rinse the filtered solid, where no amount is given
added dropwise to the aqueous residue until the system reached pH 3

procedure_text: 向2-四氢呋喃甲醇醇钠中加入70mL  DMSO，搅拌溶解后控制釜温在-5℃，将步骤(1)制备得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐(98.2％，0.1mol)分八次加入反应瓶中，总加料时间为2h，加毕保温反应5h。反应完毕，负压脱溶，釜残加水120mL，搅拌溶解后滴加浓盐酸将体系pH值酸化至3，之后经过滤、水淋洗、烘干得到产物33.4g，HPLC定量得目标化合物2-氯-3-[(RS)-四氢呋喃-2-基甲氧基甲基]-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸含量为95.5％，以2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯计两步反应收率91.5％。
procedure_summary: The solid sodium alkoxide is dissolved in dimethyl sulfoxide, the kettle is cooled below room temperature, and the sodium benzoate salt from the first step is added in portions and then held at temperature, the alkoxide displacing the benzylic bromide to give the ether. The solvent is stripped under reduced pressure, the residue is dissolved in water and acidified with concentrated hydrochloric acid added dropwise, and the product is filtered, rinsed with water and dried, its content being determined by quantitative liquid chromatography.
notes: Heading of the document's step (2), in translation: preparation of 2-chloro-3-[(RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethoxymethyl]-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid, with the remark that the main reaction process can be represented by the reaction equation that follows. That heading covers both the alkoxide preparation and this etherification, which is why its line is inside this record's provenance span. The benzylic bromide of the benzoate salt is displaced by the sodium alkoxide, hence nucleophilic_substitution with Williamson ether synthesis as the named reaction. The concentrated hydrochloric acid is a workup acidification that liberates the free acid, not a reagent of the substitution, so it sits in the workup with the pH target, and is_one_pot is false: the solvent is stripped and water added before the acid goes in, so there is a workup between the substitution and the acidification. The pH is recorded as the workup target and the reaction pH is left null, since no pH is controlled during the reaction itself.
